metadata.source: DARPA TC Ground Truth Report E3 Update, Section 3.1
metadata.description: Nginx is exploited, /tmp/vUgefal is executed, and the payload communicates with an external host. The report also describes netrecon and a failed sshd injection attempt.
metadata.selection_rule: Choose concrete downstream SENDTO symptoms for the compromised nginx process and two temporally distinct vUgefal callback episodes. Do not fabricate a netrecon POI: the imported database contains no node for netrecon, 154.145.113.18, or 61.167.39.128.
